name: Bastion

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Disintegration Vunlnerability: Gelen Disintegration etkilerinin hasar gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Reroute: Aktifken, rakibin güç kazanım oranı düştüğü ölçüde bu şampiyonun güç kazanım oranı artar.
abilityDetails.Disintegration: Aktifken doğrudan hasar verir; etkilenen şampiyonun güç kazanım oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
The Future Incarnate
Bastion's Offensive Ability Accuracy and Defensive Ability Accuracy reduction is expanded to affect non-personal effects.
Against Mutants, whenever the Opponent gains a Regeneration or Prowess effect, all of Bastion's personal Abilities are paused for [0.3 - 1.2] seconds.
Personal Fury potency increased by +[8.6 - 30%].

abilitySections.title: The Next Step in Evolution - Always Active
content: Bastion's evolved Sentinel body provides him 100% Resistance against Bleed and Poison effects, and his Regeneration Rate cannot be reduced by Poison.
When inflicted with a Bleed, Poison, or Crush effect, Bastion gains a 10 second Self-Repair Buff healing 8% of missing Health or 3% of Max Health, whichever is greater. Max stacks: 2.
The Sentinel Relic increases the potency of personal Disintegration effects by 10%. This effect is doubled when fighting Mutants.

abilitySections.title: Mechanical Armor Up Passive
content: Bastion starts each fight with an indefinite Armor Up Passive, granting +[1,650] Armor Rating. If this ends for any reason it returns after 14 seconds. While active it provides the following effects:
Bastion can trigger the Parry Mastery against non-contact attacks.

When Bastion's Block is broken due to Unblockable or Crush, he gains an Auto-Repair Passive for 2 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. While active, Bastion Instantly Regenerates 85% of all non-Special 3 damage taken. Cooldown: 24 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Techno-Mechanical Virus Charges
content: Bastion can inflict the Opponent with Techno-Mechanical Virus Charges. Virus Charges cannot be inflicted while Bastion's Opponent has more than 3 unique Buffs.
When either Champion strikes with a Medium Attack, inflict 2 Techno-Mechanical Virus Charges.
When either Champion strikes with a Light Attack, inflict 1 Techno-Mechanical Virus Charge.
When Bastion performs a Well-Timed Block, inflict 2 Techno-Mechanical Virus Charges.
When Bastion hits his Opponent's Block with his first Medium or Light Attack, inflict 1 Techno-Mechanical Virus Charge.

Each Techno-Mechanical Virus Charge decreases the Offensive Ability Accuracy and Defensive Ability Accuracy of the Opponent's personal non-Instant Energy Damaging effects and Daunted Debuffs by -5% flat, down to -40%, or -60% against Mutants.

Whenever a non-Instant Energy Damaging effect fails due to Ability Accuracy reduction, inflict a 16% Disintegration Vulnerability Passive for 28 seconds. Potency doubled against Mutants. Max stacks: 2.
As a Defender, when Bastion's Opponent activates a Special Attack, Techno-Mechanical Virus Charges are removed. Special 1: 5 Charges, Special 2: 12 Charges, Special 3: 24 Charges.

abilitySections.title: Techno-Mechanical Infection
content: When the Opponent is inflicted with 30 Techno-Mechanical Virus Charges, they are inflicted with an indefinite Techno-Mechanical Infection. When dropping below 15 Charges, Infection is removed.
While Infection is active, Virus Charges begin expiring one at a time every 1.2 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. When a Virus Charge expires, remaining Charges expire slightly faster.
While Techno-Mechanical Infection is active, Bastion's Opponent has their Attack Rating decreased by 35% and they are inflicted with a Power Reroute Passive.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit cannot be Evaded and grants a non-stacking Pursuit Passive for 10 seconds. Against Mutants this becomes 16 seconds.
The second hit inflicts a non-stacking 30% Disintegration Passive, dealing [10,593.37] Direct Damage over 16 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each beam hit inflicts an Instant 10% Disintegration, dealing [7,098.65] Direct Damage. As a Defender, this damage is halved and scales with Base Attack only.
If Infection is active: For each personal Disintegration effect on the Opponent, inflict another Instant Disintegration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, Bastion's inner turmoil grants him a +[3,931.56] Fury Passive for 28 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks. Max stacks: 2.
If Infection is active: Gain an additional Fury Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a 20% Disintegration Debuff, dealing [49,144.5] Direct Damage over 40 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Future Incarnate
content: Bastion's Offensive Ability Accuracy and Defensive Ability Accuracy reduction is expanded to affect non-personal effects.
Against Mutants, whenever the Opponent gains a Regeneration or Prowess effect, all of Bastion's personal Abilities are paused for [0.3 - 1.2] seconds.
Personal Fury potency increased by +[8.6 - 30%].
